title: PiD + SDXL-4K never generated: MpiScaledDimensions gained a required upscale_method after the graphs were exported (SETTLED, fixed offline)
description: MpiScaledDimensions gained a required upscale_method after the PiD and SDXL-4K graphs were exported, so every real output was dropped and only the input loader ran. Fixed in six nodes plus their raw twins; gate-8 root fix handed to MPI-467.
